positive.description: Discover what the plugin can read, without signing in.
positive.prompt: Which document formats can AILANG Parse read without AI?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls mcpFormats (no sign-in needed). Lists Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, HTML, Markdown, CSV, EPUB, email, LaTeX and RTF as read without AI; says images need an AI model; may mention the sample documents. Shows no prices or plans.

positive.description: Read review markup from a Word document (built-in sample, so no file is needed).
positive.prompt: Show the comments and tracked changes in the AILANG Parse sample Word document.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls mcpParse with filepath sample_docx_comments (and/or sample_docx_track_changes). Lists the comments with author (Jesse Rosenthal) and date, e.g. "I left a comment.", and the moved paragraph "Here is the text to be moved." with its author.

positive.description: Read a Word file the user attached.
positive.prompt: Summarise the structure of the Word document I attached: its headings and tables.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls mcpParse with the attached file in the file argument (outputFormat summary or markdown). Reports 4 headings (Introduction, Features, Sample Data Table, Conclusion) and 1 table (Format / Extension / Status).

positive.description: Create a new Word document from the conversation.
positive.prompt: Write a one-page project brief for a website relaunch as a Word document I can download.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the brief as Markdown and calls mcpConvert with content, filename notes.md (or similar) and outputFormat docx. Gives the user the download_url (valid for one hour); the link downloads a .docx with the brief's headings, list and table.

positive.prompt: How much of my AILANG Parse allowance have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls mcpAccount (action status). Reports the plan, requests used and remaining this month, and the AI request allowance. No upgrade prompt or prices.

negative.description: A file path on the user's own computer, which the hosted service cannot read.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not pretend to read the file. Explains that AILANG Parse cannot reach the user's disk and asks the user to attach the file or give a public link. If it tries mcpParse with the path, the tool returns INPUT_NOT_FOUND and the assistant says so.

negative.description: Audio is not processed by the hosted service.
negative.prompt: Transcribe this podcast MP3 for me with AILANG Parse.
negative.expected_behavior: Says the hosted AILANG Parse does not process audio or video (mcpFormats lists mp3 as self-host only; a call returns FORMAT_NOT_AVAILABLE) and points to the local CLI. Does not invent a transcript.

negative.description: Deleting history is deliberately not an action the plugin offers.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my AILANG Parse request history.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim to have deleted anything; there is no delete tool. Explains that history is deleted from the AILANG Parse dashboard (Delete history), and offers to stop storing new history (mcpAccount history_off) only if the user wants that.
